import ast
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import platform
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
base = root / "results/T-054"
run = base / "runs/hoan-thien-local-g3-011"
script_dir = base / "scripts"
manifest_path = base / "manifest-hoan-thien-local-g3-011.json"
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_bytes())

def check_pin(path, pin):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    assert len(data) == pin["bytes"], path
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == pin["sha256"], path

runtime_path = run / "local-runtime-environments.json"
pin_path = run / "current-code-pins.json"
policy_path = run / "failure-policy-candidate.json"
for path in (runtime_path, pin_path, policy_path):
    check_pin(path, manifest["outputs"][path.relative_to(root).as_posix()])

expected = json.loads(runtime_path.read_bytes())["main"]["snapshot"]
exe = Path(sys.executable).resolve()
assert exe == Path(expected["executable"]["path"]).resolve()
check_pin(exe, expected["executable"])
packages = {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in expected["packages"]}
threads = {name: os.environ.get(name) for name in expected["threads"]}
assert sys.version == expected["python"], sys.version
assert packages == expected["packages"], packages
assert threads == expected["threads"], threads

pins = json.loads(pin_path.read_bytes())["code_pins"]
checked_modules = ["fixtures.py", "bien_nhan.py", "nguon.py", "cham.py", "dieu_phoi.py"]
for name in checked_modules:
    path = script_dir / name
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == pins[path.relative_to(root).as_posix()], path

sys.path.insert(0, str(script_dir))
source = script_dir / "fixtures.py"
tree = ast.parse(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
main = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "main")
# Keep the exact original checks before test_grant_separate; omit mkdir and worker launches.
selected = [node for node in main.body if 22 <= node.lineno <= 83]
assert ast.unparse(selected[0]) == "checks = []"
assert "test_g3_before_IO" in ast.unparse(selected[-1])
main.body = ast.parse("target = Path(directory).resolve()").body + selected + ast.parse("return checks").body
ast.fix_missing_locations(tree)
scope = {"__name__": "read_only_fixture_slice", "__file__": str(source)}
exec(compile(tree, str(source), "exec"), scope)
existing = scope["main"](root)
assert len(existing) == 29

from bien_nhan import fingerprint, timeout_classification
policy = json.loads(policy_path.read_bytes())["monitor"]
limit = policy["max_monitor_gap_s"]
assert limit == 5
slot = {"dataset": "RE2-TT", "arm": "torai_B"}
phase = {"token": "fixture-token", "phase": "method", "state": "start", "invocation_sha256": "fixture"}
boundary = []
for gap, expected_status in [(4.999, "COMPLETE_UNVERIFIED"), (5, "BLOCKED"), (5.001, "BLOCKED"), (None, "BLOCKED")]:
    monitor = {"token": "fixture-token", "max_monitor_gap_s": gap, "last_phase_sha256": fingerprint(phase)}
    actual = timeout_classification(slot, [phase], monitor, policy)[0]
    assert actual == expected_status, (gap, expected_status, actual)
    boundary.append({"gap_s": gap, "expected": expected_status, "actual": actual})
print(json.dumps({
    "PASS": True,
    "scope": "synthetic in-memory checks; no test/RE3 data, worker process, method execution or cloud",
    "runtime": {"exe": str(exe), "python": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform(), "packages": packages, "threads": threads, "sha256": expected["executable"]["sha256"]},
    "checked_code_sha256": {name: pins[(script_dir / name).relative_to(root).as_posix()] for name in checked_modules},
    "policy_sha256": manifest["outputs"][policy_path.relative_to(root).as_posix()]["sha256"],
    "existing_fixture_checks": existing,
    "monitor_boundary_checks": boundary,
    "checks_passed": len(existing) + len(boundary),
}))
